registration.detail: Registered on init whenever Fair Events is active.

minimal.title: All public prices of the current event
minimal.description: Lists every public ticket type and sale period configured on the event's Prices tab.

hidden-ticket-types.title: Prices with a ticket type and sale period hidden
hidden-ticket-types.description: Hides one ticket type and one sale period from the price table.

syntheticIds.hiddenTicketTypeIds: IDs of ticket types of this event (Fair Events → event → Prices tab; table fair_events_ticket_types).
syntheticIds.hiddenSalePeriodIds: IDs of sale periods of this event (same tab; table fair_events_sale_periods).
